newsitem.title: USA: Ziegler names Peter Ziegler as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Ziegler names Peter Ziegler as chairman.

text.p: Ziegler Cos Inc, a financial services holding company, said Monday chief executive officer and president Peter Ziegler was named to the additional post of chairman.
He succeeds his father, R. Douglas Ziegler, who retired effective March 17.
Peter Ziegler also is president and chief executive officer of the company's principal operating subsidiary, B.C. Ziegler and Co, an investment banking and brokerage firm.

Separately, the company reaffirmed its intention to repurchase shares of its common stock in the open market, in keeping with a previous authorization. The remaining authorization of Ziegler to buy its shares in the open market covers about 80,000 shares.
